title: review: LS1 complete: bring task/T-1592 onto this branch and update the CLI handover test to the new hook text
spec:
Replaces the stuck T-1592 fix chain (fix rounds resume the parent's session and keep its scope, which lacks tests/test_cli.py). Branch task/T-1592 holds the finished LS1 work: 3b26f12 (planner_context.compact_brief, new hook_message text, plan_max_chars nag, `planner-context --brief`, .claude/hooks/planner-compact.sh) and 55bfc04 (its acceptance tests). All five tests pass there; one existing test is stale.

1. First step, before any edit: `git merge --ff-only task/T-1592` (this worktree is cut from goal/T-1590 at 408738b, an ancestor). Confirm `git log --oneline -3` shows 55bfc04. If the merge is not a fast-forward, stop and report.
2. tests/test_cli.py::test_handover_cli_forwards_session_id asserts 'hand over now' in the planner-context hook output. T-1592 changed that text on purpose to 'Planner context is N tokens (threshold T); write the checkpoint: <command>; then keep working, the session compacts in place (auto-compact or /compact).'. Update the assertion to check 'write the checkpoint', 'compacts in place' and that the command still carries '--session-id S'. Do not change the orchestrator code back.
A 'RuntimeError: boom' traceback in test logs comes from a test that raises on purpose. Keep test methods inside their TestCase classes; no module-level test functions. Run tests/test_cli.py, tests/test_planner_context.py and tests/test_hooks.py and commit.
acceptance: git log shows 3b26f12 and 55bfc04 on this branch

result.summary: Fast-forward of task/T-1592 is in place: 3b26f12 and 55bfc04 are in the log, with 8b990d5 on top. The test_cli.py change matches the spec (checks 'write the checkpoint', 'compacts in place' and '--session-id S'), and the orchestrator code was not reverted. All six named tests exist as methods inside TestCase classes. I did not run them; the packet reports the gate green. The hook exits 0 on every path and does nothing for workers, the non-planner mode, or a failed uv call. Remaining risks are low severity.

comments.issue: The plan-size nag has no once-per-session throttle, so it repeats on every prompt while plan.md is over plan_max_chars. This is within the spec but noisy.
Nothing in scope registers this hook as a SessionStart(compact) hook in settings, so it will not fire until a separate change wires it up. Acceptance only requires the test.
